capabilities: Highlight selected text inside fenced code blocks via a command or ^^ markers
Edit highlights in Live Preview with markers hidden until the cursor enters them
Copy code from Reading view with markers removed while keeping comments and indentation
Configure highlight font and background colors and interface language
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13+; installable via BRAT or manual download; the highlight command only works in ordinary top-level fenced code blocks (Mermaid and other special blocks are excluded); linked sections cover upgrading from the old HTML plugin and development.
intentEvidence: Upgrading from the old HTML plugin
motivation: The author wants the important parts of code in notes to be easier to revisit.
problem: Obsidian code blocks have no built-in way to mark and revisit specific fragments or comments as important.

relations.evidence: Upgrading from the old HTML plugin

summary: Code highlighter that marks important parts of code blocks in notes with ^^ emphasis markers that stay hidden while reading.
